question: is there a club for anime or gaming?
answer:
Yes. **Geek and Nerd Culture** is for fans of games, anime, science fiction and fantasy films, and tabletop RPGs. It has Discord chat, Minecraft servers, D&D campaigns, seasonal events, and show, movie, and board game nights. The club has watched anime and played games including Jackbox. [8][9] Page: https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/geek-nerd-culture-club/; Archway: https://archway.ramapo.edu/GNCulture/ [1]

Gaming clubs include **Rhythm Game Club** [2], **Trading Card Game Club** [3], **Ramapo Gamers Club** [4], and **Ramapo Girls in Gaming** [5]. Rhythm Game Club offers weekly meetings and events, and welcomes players of all backgrounds; no prior experience is required. Email: rrgc@ramapo.edu. [12] Trading Card Game Club welcomes new, casual, and competitive players. Email: tcg@ramapo.edu. [16]

For Geek and Nerd Culture, email nerdsrcnj@ramapo.edu. [9]

question: how do i find and join a club here, i dont even know where to look
answer:
1. Start exploring clubs on Archway: https://archway.ramapo.edu/. You can also download the Archway App from the Apple Store or Google Play. [1][2]
2. Browse the club list at https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/. The listed clubs are open to all students, and the page says groups welcome new members. [4][6]
3. The pages differ on the number of clubs: sections 1–2 say more than 100; sections 4 and 6 say more than 80. [1][2][4][6]
4. The Center for Student Involvement (SC-202) can help you get more information. Email csi@ramapo.edu or call (201) 684-7593. [3][4]
5. Section 3 also lists a Student Involvement Fair on Wednesday, August 26; that date has passed. [3] Section 8 is a January 15, 2023 message for the Spring semester, which has passed. [8]
If the listed clubs don’t represent your interests, inquire with the Center for Student Involvement about starting a new club. [4]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/commuter-affairs/involvement-frequently-asked-questions/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-affairs/welcome-back-to-student-involvement-events-connections-more/)
